props.name: accept
props.description: Allowed types, like the HTML `accept` attribute: "image/*" or ".pdf,.png". Leave out to allow all.

props.name: maxSizeMB
props.description: Largest file in megabytes. Bigger files are refused.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Most files that can be held at once.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Called with the full list of held files whenever it changes.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called with a message when a file is refused.

props.name: label
props.description: Main line shown inside the zone.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops all interaction and dims the zone.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
